Record Class AgentArgs

java.lang.Object
java.lang.Record
com.macstab.chaos.jvm.startup.AgentArgs
Record Components:
values - unmodifiable key-value map; never null
public record AgentArgs(Map<String,String> values) extends Record
Immutable view of parsed agent arguments.

Key lookups are case-sensitive and return null when the key is absent. Boolean lookups accept the canonical set true|false|1|0|yes|no|on|off (case-insensitive). Unrecognised values fall back to the supplied default after a warning to stderr, so operators notice typos instead of silently getting the default.

    • getLong

      @Deprecated(since="2.0.0", forRemoval=true) public long getLong(String key, long defaultValue)
      Deprecated, for removal: This API element is subject to removal in a future version.
      no agent argument is a plain long any more (configWatchInterval and the other numbers are read by AgentSettings with their own validation); read the value with get(key) and parse it. To be removed in the next major release.
      Returns the long value for key, or defaultValue if absent or unparseable.

      The raw string is stripped of leading/trailing whitespace before parsing. Any non-numeric value (including blank) silently yields defaultValue.

      Parameters:
      key - the argument key to look up
      defaultValue - value returned when the key is absent or its value is not a valid long
      Returns:
      the parsed long, or defaultValue

    • getBoolean

      public boolean getBoolean(String key, boolean defaultValue)
      Returns the boolean value for key.

      Accepts true|false|1|0|yes|no|on|off (case-insensitive) with surrounding whitespace trimmed. Any other non-blank value emits a one-line warning to System.err naming the key and the offending literal, then returns defaultValue. Blank or missing keys silently fall back.

      Parameters:
      key - argument key to look up
      defaultValue - value returned when the key is absent or its value is unrecognised
      Returns:
      the parsed boolean, or defaultValue

    • parseBoolean

      public static boolean parseBoolean(String name, @Nullable String raw, boolean defaultValue)
      Parses a boolean flag the way agent args do (true|false|1|0|yes|no|on|off, case insensitive); also used for the equivalent environment variables so both spellings behave the same.
      Parameters:
      name - the arg or variable name, for the warning on an unrecognised value
      raw - the raw value; null or blank means defaultValue
      defaultValue - the value when raw is absent or unrecognised
      Returns:
      the parsed flag

    • parseBooleanQuietly

      @Internal public static @Nullable Boolean parseBooleanQuietly(@Nullable String raw)
      Parses a boolean the way parseBoolean(String, String, boolean) does, without printing anything: for callers that report an unrecognised value through their own log.
      Parameters:
      raw - the raw value
      Returns:
      true or false for true|false|1|0|yes|no|on|off (case insensitive, surrounding whitespace ignored); null for null, blank or any other text
